game.howto.1.text: Di light (ivory) pieces na your own, dem start for bottom. Tap one piece, then tap one marked square make e move. You fit drag am too. Pieces dey waka one square for slant, go front.

game.howto.2.text: Capture na must. Jump pass enemy piece land for di empty square wey dey behind am. Men fit capture go front and go back. Any piece wey fit capture go get warning triangle.

game.howto.3.text: For 10x10 you must carry di most pieces wey you fit carry for one move (majority rule). For 8x8 na switch for di Rules page, e dey on from start. Jumps fit continue like chain, and di numbered stones go show your road. Dem no fit jump one piece two times, and di captured pieces go comot for board only when di whole move don finish.

game.howto.4.text: Reach di far row make you turn king. For 10x10, king dey fly for slant, any distance, and e fit capture from far. If man pass di far row for middle of capture and e still dey jump, e no go turn king.

game.howto.5.text: If plenty captures end for di same square, tap di numbered stone where di roads separate make you choose one.

game.howto.6.text: You win when di other side no get piece again or no get move. If di same position show three times, or 25 moves each with only kings and no capture, e be draw.

game.howto.7.text: Choose 10x10 (international) or 8x8 (short game) for menu. You dey stuck? Tap Hint. For keyboard use arrow keys, Enter, Escape, H for hint and P to pause. Di Rules page get switches for 8x8 and for who go start.

rules.intro.text: 10x10 dey always follow di international rules. Di switches below dey change di 8x8 short game and who go start. Di computer dey follow di same rules wey you dey follow.

rules.draws.text: Draw na: di same position three times, or 25 moves each wey only kings dey move and no capture.

rules.max.help.text: On: you must play di capture wey carry di most pieces. Off: any capture fit work. For 10x10 na di most dey always count.

rules.fly.help.text: On: king dey slide and capture from any distance. Off: king dey move one square. For 10x10 kings dey always fly.

rules.cpuStarts.help.text: On: di computer (dark) go make di first move. Off: you (light) go start.

rules.fast.help.text: Pieces go slide quick and di computer go think about 1.7 times faster.

legend.move.text: Square wey you fit move go

legend.path.text: Numbered stone for di capture road

play.yourTurn.text: Na your turn. Tap one piece, then one marked square.

play.mustCapture.text: You must capture. Carry di most pieces wey you fit carry.

play.pickPath.text: Tap di numbered stone make you choose your road.

play.youChain.text: You don chop {n} pieces for one go!

play.cpuChain.text: {name} don chop {n} pieces for one go.

play.end.noPieces.text: No piece remain again. Di game don end.

play.end.blocked.text: No move remain again. Di game don end.

play.end.repetition.text: Di same position three times: e be draw.

play.end.kingMoves.text: 25 moves each wey na only kings: e be draw.

play.end.cap.text: Di game don too long: e be draw.

persona.doosuur.1.text: Welcome, my dear. Sit down, make we play small.

persona.doosuur.2.text: Take your time. Nobody dey run us.

persona.doosuur.3.text: Ah, correct move! You see that one fast.

persona.doosuur.4.text: Oh! You don chop my piece. Well done.

persona.doosuur.5.text: Look well o, one jump dey wait you.

persona.doosuur.8.text: Good game, my dear. Make we run am again.

persona.falmata.2.text: Two for one. I like that kind exchange.

persona.falmata.4.text: Capture must o, my friend. Na the rule.

persona.falmata.6.text: Ha! You see my shot before e land.

persona.falmata.7.text: I don crown! Now I dey fly.

persona.damola.1.text: Ó dára! Make the better player win.

persona.damola.2.text: I don dey play this one since secondary school.

persona.damola.3.text: That move sharp. I no expect am.

persona.damola.4.text: Careful. Every piece get im weight.

persona.damola.5.text: Ah! You don scatter my formation.

persona.damola.8.text: Another one? Board still dey hot.
